connector.name: TokenOracle
connector.registryDescription: Hosted MCP server for LLM cost estimation, model comparison, and budget-aware routing.
connector.summary: Hosted at mcp.guffeyholdings.com over streamable HTTP, also runs locally from the npm package token-oracle-mcp. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches all 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the domain namespace com.guffeyholdings. The registry required proof of control over that domain before accepting the record.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.
